references.title: Trial comparing blastocyst transfer with cleavage stage transfer in women with increased maternal age
references.original-title: Blastocyst stage vs cleavage stage transfer in women with increased maternal age: a prospective randomised controlled trial

characteristics.name: Study name
characteristics.value: Trial comparing blastocyst transfer with cleavage stage transfer in women with increased maternal age

characteristics.name: Methods
characteristics.value: Prospective randomised double-blinded study

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value:
Inclusion criteria

  • Female participants aged between 37 and 42 years undergoing an IVF/ICSI attempt at the GENERA Centre for Reproductive Medicine in Rome
  • History of less than 3 failed IVF/ICSI cycles
  • ≥ 6 MII retrieved
  • Signed consent form

characteristics.name: Interventions
characteristics.value:
Participants will be randomised on the day of ovum pick up by an independent operator to:

  1. Blastocyst transfer
    1. Ovarian stimulation by agonist or antagonist protocol
    2. Ovum pick up performed 36 hours after human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) administration
    3. In vitro fertilization performed by intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI)
    4. In vitro culture performed with sequential media in 6% CO2 and 5% O2 atmosphere
    5. Embryo transfer on day 5 two best quality blastocyst. Remaining blastocyst preserved by vitrification procedureLuteal support by progesterone 200 mg vaginally three times a day from oocyte retrieval plus one day
  2. Cleavage stage transfer
    1. Ovarian stimulation by agonist or antagonist protocol
    2. Ovum pick up performed 36 hours after human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) administration 
    3. In vitro fertilization performed by intra-cytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI)
    4. In vitro culture performed with sequential media in 6% CO2 and 5% O2 atmosphere
    5. Embryo transfer on day 3 two best quality embryos. Remaining embryos preserved by vitrification procedure
    6. Luteal support by progesterone 200 mg vaginally three times a day from oocyte retrieval plus one day

characteristics.name: Outcomes
characteristics.value: Cumulative live birth rate after blastocyst or cleavage stage strategy including pregnancies from fresh + cryoembryos transferred within 6 months after the end of the treatment

references.title: Non-inferiority of cleavage-stage versus blastocyst-stage embryo transfer in poor prognosis IVF patients (PRECiSE trial): study protocol for a randomized controlled trial

characteristics.name: Study name
characteristics.value: Day 3 vs day 5 embryo transfer for patients with low embryo numbers going through in vitro fertilization

characteristics.name: Methods
characteristics.value:
Phase 2. Allocation: randomized
Intervention model: parallel assignment
Intervention model description: non-inferiority

Masking: none (open label)
Primary purpose: treatment

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value:
18 to 44 years old

Inclusion criteria

  • First autologous IVF cycle
  • Written, informed consent

Exclusion criteria

  • Planned gestational carrier
  • Planned donor egg
  • Morbid obesity: BMI > 40
  • History of recurrent pregnancy loss (≥ 2 spontaneous abortions)
  • Presence of uterine factor infertility
  • Treatment plan includes embryos cultured "out of protocol"
  • Planned preimplantation genetic testing

characteristics.name: Interventions
characteristics.value:
- Uterine transfer of embryo on day 3 after fertilisation (cleavage stage)

- Uterine transfer of embryo on day 5 after fertilisation (blastocyst stage)

  • Procedure: day 3 uterine transfer
  • Procedure: day 5 uterine transfer

characteristics.name: Outcomes
characteristics.value: Live birth [time frame: 9 months], defined as delivery of a live born infant ≥ 22 weeks of gestation

references.title: Comparative study of clinical outcomes after day-3 cleavage stage and day-5 blastocyst stage embryo transfer in-vitro fertilization at the Fertility Unit of Federal Mical Centre, Abuja

characteristics.name: Study name
characteristics.value: Comparative study of clinical outcomes after day-3 cleavage stage and day-5 blastocyst stage embryo transfer in-vitro fertilization at the Fertility Unit of Federal Mical Centre, Abuja

characteristics.name: Methods
characteristics.value:
Crossover: all participants receive all interventions in different sequence during study

Simple randomization using a randomization table created by a computer software program

Sealed opaque envelopes

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value:
Inclusion criteria

  1. Age must be between 18-39 years
  2. Normal baseline hormonal profile (FSH, LH, E2, Prolactin, and AMH)
  3. Normal uterine cavity confirmed by hysterosalpingogram or hysteroscopy

Exclusion criteria

  1. Maternal age above 39 years
  2. Women who did not fulfill inclusion criteria
  3. Women who had endocrine or metabolic disorder
  4. Women who had a history of chemotherapy or radiotherapy
  5. Women with uterine anomalies, or focal endometrial lesions (fibroid, polyp, adhesion, endometritis, etc.)
  6. Patients with more than 3 unsuccessful IVF attempts
  7. Patients with any contraindication for pregnancy
  8. Refusal or inability to comply with the requirements of the study protocol for any reason, including scheduled clinic visits and laboratory tests

characteristics.name: Interventions
characteristics.value:
Experimental group: day 5 blastocyst stage embryo transfer

Control group: day 3 cleavage stage embryo transfer

characteristics.name: Outcomes
characteristics.value:
Primary outcomes

  1. Positive pregnancy test conducted two weeks after embryo transfer
  2. Pregnancy confirmation via ultrasound revealing intrauterine gestation at 2 weeks after positive pregnancy test (4 weeks following embryo transfer)
  3. Ongoing pregnancy by 20 weeks gestation

Secondary outcomes

1. Fertilization rates

2. Cleavage rates

3. Blastulation rates

4. Multiple pregnancy rates

5. Early pregnancy losses including: ectopic pregnancy and miscarriages occurring before 20 weeks
